newsitem.title: USA: Wash.-Canada power line re-energized over weekend.
newsitem.headline: Wash.-Canada power line re-energized over weekend.

text.p: The double circuit 500 kilovolt Raver-Schultz power line, running from Snohomish County, Wash., to Canada, was re-energized over the weekend, Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Monday.
One circuit of the line was repaired Friday, while work on the second circuit took slightly longer, BPA said.
The Raver-Schultz lines were damaged during ice storm just over two weeks ago.
During part of the outage, BPA had to restrict hydroelectric power generation at certain dams due to voltage support concerns related to the transmission line outage.
